verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rippling runs payroll and pays employees electronically. The global-payroll pages claim workers are paid 'without waiting on transfers or conversion', and a community comment notes payouts going through JP Morgan Chase. Nothing explicitly documents direct deposit or next-day/2-day timing. missing for 10: explicit direct deposit documentation, stated next-day or 2-day deposit speeds, funding deadlines/cutoffs, independent hands-on corroboration of deposit timing.
